name: js_eval
summary: Evaluates `code` as JavaScript in the context of the page (or node process) hosting the WASM driver and returns the result as a string: primitives are stringified, objects are JSON-encoded, undefined/null become "". A thrown JavaScript exception is returned as the string "JS error: ..." — it never unwinds into the driver.

availability.condition: 仅 EMSCRIPTEN 且启用 PACKAGE_JSBRIDGE 时可用
